newsitem.title: USA: Exxon says Baytown units operate normally.
newsitem.headline: Exxon says Baytown units operate normally.

text.p: Exxon Corp said Thursday that the two cat cracking units were operating normally at its giant Baytown, Texas refinery, contrary to reports circulating in the market.

The market talk was based on an erroneous report last week that the units were due to come down from maintenance in mid-January, according to an official at Exxon USA, the unit which operates domestic refineries.

The plant has capacity to process 396,000 bpd of crude oil and has two fluid catalytic cracking units (FCCUs), with capacities to process 88,000 bpd and 102,000 bpd. Cat crackers turn feedstock into gasoline and other products.
Exxon's policy is not to comment on future maintenance plans for its plants but to confirm when units go into turnaround, the spokesman said.
